capabilities: Hold back sidebar swipe move events until horizontal travel passes a threshold
Repair phone/tablet body classes after a resize
Hide the top tab bar with floating toggle and replacement sidebar buttons
Turn off the core tab title bar setting at startup
Store settings per device in local storage
disambiguation: Not a collaboration or device-pairing tool; it adjusts Obsidian Mobile's touch and layout behavior on foldable phones.
extras: Developed and tested on an iPhone Duo; the README says Android foldables such as Galaxy Fold and Pixel Fold have the same issues. The layout guard works at the CSS class level, so a mixed layout can still need an app restart.
intentEvidence: There is no stock setting to disable the sidebar swipe; this is the middle ground.
problem: On foldable phones the sidebar drawer follows short taps and small movements, and Obsidian can pick the wrong phone or tablet layout after folding, with no stock setting to correct either.
summary: Mobile fix pack for foldable phones that calms the sidebar swipe, repairs phone/tablet layout mix-ups, and hides the tab bar.
